    Coset invariance of normal-orbit translations #

    For a normal subgroup N ◁ G, ambient elements representing the same coset in G / N induce canonically naturally isomorphic translation functors on the N-shift-orbit category. The same comparison is transported to the chosen strict deck-orbit skeleton. These isomorphisms are the descent datum for the residual quotient-group shift.
